name: Project Pull
org: SF Public Utilities Commission and partner City departments
what_you_do: Paid summer internships in City departments for high school students, with a focus on STEAM careers and public service, such as architecture, business, engineering and science.
who_can_apply: San Francisco high school students (there are separate college tracks). The application page says details are coming soon.
pay_detail: Paid (rate not posted on the page read)
deadline_text: The 2027 timeline on the application page says 'details coming soon'. Dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the High School Internship application page. Questions: sfprojectpull1996@gmail.com.
notes: The pages do not list age, pay or a deadline yet. Check the application page in early 2027.
